decisions.title: Auth approach
decisions.decision: Custom Go auth (JWT + bcrypt + refresh tokens). No Keycloak/SuperTokens for v1.
decisions.rationale: Keycloak is 1.5GB Java for email+password only. Custom Go is ~500 lines. Clean port boundary in internal/identity/ enables migration to Keycloak/SuperTokens when OAuth/MFA needed.

decisions.title: Access token lifetime
decisions.rationale: RFC 9700 recommendation for financial apps. Short window limits damage from stolen token.

decisions.title: Refresh token lifetime
decisions.decision: 14 days with single-use rotation. Absolute session limit 90 days.
decisions.rationale: Enables 'always logged in' UX. Token rotation detects theft via reuse detection. 90-day absolute limit forces periodic re-auth.

decisions.title: Refresh token storage (server)
decisions.decision: PostgreSQL refresh_tokens table with hashed tokens. Supports revocation per-token and per-user.
decisions.rationale: Matches existing stack. Enables logout-all-devices. No Redis needed at pfin's scale.

decisions.title: Token storage (client)
decisions.decision: Access token in memory (React state). Refresh token in httpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Strict cookie.
decisions.rationale: XSS-safe — JavaScript cannot access refresh token. Access token never in localStorage.

decisions.title: Silent refresh
decisions.decision: Frontend Axios interceptor detects 401, calls /auth/refresh, retries original request transparently.
decisions.rationale: User never sees login screen within the 14-day refresh window. Standard pattern used by Spotify, Netflix.

decisions.title: Password requirements
decisions.decision: Minimum 8 characters + at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one number, one special character.
decisions.rationale: User preference for complexity rules despite NIST 800-63B recommending length-only.

decisions.title: Email verification
decisions.decision: Skipped for v1. All signups immediately active.
decisions.rationale: Simplifies v1. Add email verification when Resend integration is built (budget alerts feature).

decisions.title: OAuth/social login
decisions.rationale: Ship faster. Clean port boundary enables adding OAuth providers later.

decisions.title: Password hashing
decisions.rationale: Slow by design, includes salt. Industry standard. golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt.

decisions.title: JWT signing
decisions.decision: HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) with shared secret from env var JWT_SECRET
decisions.rationale: Simplest for single-service architecture. Upgrade to RS256 if service count grows.

constraints: internal/identity/ must not import from other bounded contexts (only pkg/ shared kernel)
JWT middleware lives in internal/common/auth/ — shared across all contexts
Refresh tokens must be hashed before storage (never store raw tokens)
All auth endpoints must be rate-limited
Password validation happens in domain layer, not handlers

research.path: inline (agent research, not persisted as file)
research.relevance: Modern auth patterns (Uber/Spotify/Netflix), Keycloak vs custom vs SuperTokens vs Ory Kratos. Recommends custom Go auth for v1.

shapeFeedback.summary: Identity context confirmed as replaceable generic subdomain — clean port boundary enables migration to Keycloak/SuperTokens when OAuth/MFA needed
shapeFeedback.suggestedAction: No shape change needed — already aligned
